name: Call a graph over HTTP
description: Echo a message from a POST body

data.noteContent:
GraphInput declares a named, typed input and GraphOutput a named output: together they are the graph's HTTP contract. On the canvas the input falls back to its default, so Run works with no caller.

Save the graph first; the run API executes saved graphs by name. Then

POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/graph/run/<saved name>
header X-CodefyUI-Token: the token in ~/CodefyUI/.codefyui_dev/session.token
body {"inputs": {"message": "hi"}}

The reply is a run envelope, with the echoed value at outputs.echo. GET /api/graph/contract/<saved name> needs no token, so keep secrets out of a default value.

GraphInput 宣告一個具名、有型別的輸入，GraphOutput 宣告一個具名的輸出；兩者合起來就是這張圖的 HTTP 介面。在畫布上執行時輸入會用自己的預設值，所以不需要任何呼叫端。

請先存檔：run API 是用「存檔時取的名字」去執行圖的。接著

POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/graph/run/<存檔名稱>
標頭 X-CodefyUI-Token：~/CodefyUI/.codefyui_dev/session.token 裡的 token
內容 {"inputs": {"message": "hi"}}

回應是一個 run envelope，回傳的值在 outputs.echo。GET /api/graph/contract/<存檔名稱> 會列出介面而且不需要 token，所以別把機密放進預設值。
